members.name: Aleks Meyerle
members.bio: Hi, my name is Aleksander Meyerle, and I am from Frederick, Maryland. I am studying Professional Flight with the goal of becoming an airline pilot.

members.name: Dylan Morgan
members.bio: Hey, my name is Dylan Morgan and I am a junior studying Mechanical Engineering from Hoover, Alabama. My goal is to become a nuclear engineer and eventually a Senior Reactor Operator at a nuclear plant. Outside of Theta Xi, I am heavily involved in my campus ministry, The Auburn Wesley Foundation, and I am the GIS sub team lead for Auburn’s Engineers Without Borders Bolivia team.

members.name: Hayes Pieper
members.bio: Hello, my name is Hayes Pieper. I am a senior in Civil Engineering. After graduation, I would like to get a job in Environmental or Geotechnical Engineering. I am from Wetumpka, Alabama. I am a member of WESA and ASCE.

members.name: Daniel Weng
members.bio: My name is Daniel Weng. I am a nursing major from Auburn, Alabama. After college, I hope to eventually become a CRNA.

members.name: Joe Goza
members.bio: Hi, my name is Joe Goza and I’m a business finance major here at Auburn, and I’m the Recruitment Chairman of Theta Xi. I grew up 30 minutes south of Kansas City, Kansas with my four brothers and three sisters, so I’ve always been super family oriented. People would describe me as outgoing and I would have to agree with them since I’m always looking to meet new people and make new connections. WAR EAGLE!

members.name: Carter Parnell
members.bio: Hi! I'm Carter Parnell, a rising senior from Fort Mill, South Carolina majoring in professional flight. I recently earned my instrument rating and am halfway to my commercial license, with my sights set on a mainline like American or Delta. That lifelong love for people and aviation drives my service to the fraternity as social chair. Outside Theta Xi, I represent Auburn’s NGPA and have a passion for music and the outdoors!

members.name: James Hart
members.bio: Hey, my name is James Hart and I am a sophomore studying Chemical Engineering from Atlanta, Georgia. My goal is to work with renewable energy, either through working as a nuclear engineer or as a researcher. Outside of Theta Xi, I am researching for the Goldsmith Group, and I am a member of Engineers Without Borders.
